standard_prerequisites.name: The simplicial-site situation with a sheaf of rings
standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 2093-2095: O is a sheaf of rings on C_total; g_{n!} is as in lemma-restriction-module-to-components-site (card L46168).

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the functors g_{n!}
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 2103-2105: the proof uses the description of g_{n!} from the restriction lemmas.

standard_prerequisites.name: The free module on a simplicial set and homotopy invariance
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 2114-2132: g_m^{-1} of the complex is the free O_m-module on the simplicial set Delta[m]; Delta[m] is homotopy equivalent to Delta[0] and taking free abelian sheaves is functorial.

core_obligations: The complex and its differentials (proof lines 2103-2114): the maps are sum (-1)^i d^n_i with d^n_i : g_{n!}O_n -> g_{n-1!}O_{n-1} adjoint to the map O_n -> (direct sum over [n-1] -> [n] of) O_n = g_n^*g_{n-1!}O_{n-1} labeled by the face delta^n_i : [n-1] -> [n].

The g_m^{-1} image (lines 2114-2119): applying g_m^{-1} gives the direct-sum complex over Mor_Delta([n],[m]) of copies of O_m on C_m, i.e. the complex associated to the free O_m-module on the simplicial set Delta[m].

Acyclicity (lines 2124-2132): Delta[m] is homotopy equivalent to Delta[0]; since taking free abelian sheaves is functorial, the complex is homotopy equivalent to the free abelian sheaf on Delta[0], which is acyclic in positive degrees and equal to O_m in degree 0; hence the complex resolves O.
proof_roadmap: Define the differentials as the adjoints of the face maps.
Apply g_m^{-1} to identify the complex with the free module on Delta[m].
Transfer the homotopy equivalence Delta[m] simeq Delta[0] through the free-sheaf functor to conclude acyclicity.
difficulty_reason: Resolution lemma (statement 2091-2101, proof 2103-2132): constructs the resolution ... -> g_{2!}O_2 -> g_{1!}O_1 -> g_{0!}O_0 of O with alternating-sum differentials, then verifies acyclicity by transporting the standard homotopy equivalence Delta[m] simeq Delta[0] through the free-sheaf functor; no verification is omitted. H2: standard simplicial resolution transplanted to the ringed total site.
